visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young boy with short, neatly trimmed dark hair stands in front of a colorful retail display. He wears large, bright pink heart-shaped glasses that cover half his face. He holds a soft, peach-colored squishy toy shaped like a human breast with both hands, looking down at it with a curious expression. The background is filled with Japanese signage, price tags, and various small hanging toys, illuminated by bright, overhead fluorescent store lighting. (2) The scene cuts to a well-lit, modern airport terminal with glossy white floors and high ceilings. A young man with wavy dark hair, wearing a black face mask and a black graphic t-shirt, sits on a black suitcase. He holds the young boy, who is now wearing a black t-shirt, on his lap. Both look directly into the camera as they pose for a selfie-style shot. In the background, other travelers with luggage can be seen walking through the wide corridor. (3) The duo is seen outdoors on a vibrant urban street at night. The man, still wearing his black mask and graphic tee, holds the camera high for a selfie. The boy stands beside him, still wearing his pink heart glasses. Tall palm trees and brightly lit store signs in Japanese and English line the street. The lighting is dominated by colorful neon and warm street lamps. (4) The setting shifts to a traditional Japanese shrine area during the day. The man wears a plain cream-colored t-shirt and a black mask. The boy, wearing a black and white striped shirt and his pink glasses, leans in to kiss the man on the cheek. Behind them is a traditional red wooden shrine structure with intricate architectural details and a tiered roof. (5) They are captured inside a darkened room filled with dozens of large, translucent glowing balloons in shades of pink and yellow. The man holds the boy closely; both wear matching red floral patterned shirts. The light from the balloons reflects off their skin and hair, creating a soft, ethereal glow. (6) Finally, they pose inside a large shopping mall beneath a massive golden dragon statue suspended from the ceiling. The man kneels and touches the boy's face gently.
